title: Exact and Efficient Methods for Identifying Carcinogenic Multi-Hit Gene Combinations
summary: Cancer is driven by an estimated two to nine gene mutations, known as multi-hit combinations. Due to the large number of genes, identifying these multi-hit combinations presents a computationally challenging problem, which has previously required supercomputers to enumerate all or most gene combinations. Recent work formulated this classification task as the Multi-Hit Cancer Driver Set Cover Problem (MHCDSCP) and solved it via column generation on a single commodity CPU, where a pricing problem identifies promising gene combinations (arXiv:2602.22551).
